## Negative Prompt Guidance
- no fantasy drone design
- no sci-fi military drone
- no extra propellers
- no phone-in-hand control UI
- no invented GPS interface
- no fake obstacle avoidance demo
- no fake resolution overlay
- no fake brand logos
- no text overlays baked into footage
- no cartoon style
- no broken anatomy on hands
- no impossible camera movement
